description: This file defines a Flutter widget named OffersCarousel, which displays a carousel of promotional banners with automatic sliding behavior and dot indicators for navigation.

classes.name: OffersCarousel
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a carousel of promotional banners with automatic page transitions and dot indicators.

classes.name: _OffersCarouselState
classes.description: The state class managing the carousel's page index, page controller, and timer for automatic slide transitions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the page controller and sets up a periodic timer to change the banner displayed every 4 seconds.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources like the page controller and cancels the timer when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, presenting the carousel pages and dot indicators.
